fields.subject: SQL Server Service Registration
fields.trigger: an application invokes AddSqlServices with an IServiceCollection and IConfiguration
fields.response: configure the configuration hierarchy for SQL global, database-connection, and shard-connection options, and register singleton SQL database and shard-set services
fields.postcondition: the invocation returns the supplied IServiceCollection
